name: argus-ai-hub
description: Your command center for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI sessions. Watch every session live, send commands, and stop runaway agents, all from a single browser tab.
author: aarthi-ntrjn

scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=backend && npm run test:coverage --workspace=frontend
scripts.test:coverage:e2e: cross-env VITE_COVERAGE=true npm run build --workspace=frontend && cross-env VITE_COVERAGE=true npm run test:e2e --workspace=frontend && node scripts/merge-e2e-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:coverage:e2e:real: cross-env NODE_V8_COVERAGE=./backend/coverage-e2e/raw npm run test:e2e:real --workspace=frontend && npx c8 report --reporter=json-summary --reporter=text --src=backend/src --temp-directory=backend/coverage-e2e/raw --reports-dir=backend/coverage-e2e --all
scripts.test:coverage:all: npm run test:coverage && npm run test:coverage:e2e && npm run test:coverage:e2e:real && node scripts/generate-coverage-report.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:real
